product.title: Dublin to Belfast Titanic, Dunluce Castle & Giant's Causeway Tour

description.text: Leave Dublin on a 13-hour coach day to Titanic Belfast, Dunluce Castle, and Giant's Causeway. A guide covers the liner's story in the Belfast galleries, then the Antrim Coast Road to Dunluce Castle and the UNESCO basalt columns. Admission to Titanic Belfast and Dunluce Castle is included so gallery and castle timing stay on one vehicle. Drop-off is on D'Olier Street near O'Connell Bridge. The long day is built for visitors who want Belfast shipyard history and Antrim coast geology from a Dublin base. Stops include Titanic Belfast, Antrim Coast Road, Dunluce Castle, Giant's Causeway, Castlebellingham.
